summary: This technology family concerns a formulation stabilizer system designed to prevent the photodegradation of organic UV filters (e.g., avobenzone) in daily skincare creams. It utilizes a synergistic combination of oil-in-water emulsifiers and antioxidant stabilizers to form an advanced, photostable lipid matrix.
